propositions: The Pass-2/Pass-3 judge must exhibit self-consistency across repeated runs (≥3 votes per finding) to validate R5's new sub-answer asserted_capability_confirmed; measured via Fleiss' κ≥0.6 and raw agreement≥0.8 over 50 findings from the G6/E4/T3 cohort.

Section-order permutation of plan input must not flip the gate verdict (PASS↔BLOCK or PASS↔INDETERMINATE); measured via Fleiss' κ≥0.6 and raw agreement≥0.8 over 3 distinct orderings of 14 permutable plans (≥3 top-level sections each) to establish R3 prerequisite stability.

Infra-level INDETERMINATE verdicts (llm_unavailable or verify_failed in coverage) are execution failures, not stable judge outcomes, and must be excluded and re-run; genuine judge-INDETERMINATE (neither flag set) counts as its own agreement category.

Per-finding 3-vote self-consistency infra-exclusion: any vote returning indeterminate due to null Pass-2 result (Pass-2 error or agentic no-verdict) is dropped and re-run up to a retry cap until 3 substantive votes (block/advisory/dropped) are collected or the finding is reported as excluded.

Frozen inputs for reproducibility: Exp A snapshots 50 findings' plan text + finding record once via rebar show; Exp B commits section-order permutations (identity + 2 seeded per-plan, all distinct) to runs/ before live judge re-runs.

Judge re-runs for stability are bounded and billable: Exp A = 150 agentic Pass-2 calls (50 findings × 3 votes); Exp B = 42 full-gate runs (14 plans × 3 permutations), sub-sampling the committed corpora rather than the full adjudication/outcome corpus.
